rules.question: How wide is a table column?
rules.decision: D243 to D245 (the user's answers on column widths, 2026-10-14)

owner_lines.why: setup_column: every column is fixed width, at the width place_columns gave it
setup_column: the one TableSetupColumn call in src
apply_column_widths: the one writer of a column's width, from place_columns' layout

rules.note: Every table goes through setup_column and apply_column_widths, so a table that sets up its own column, sets a width, or hands ImGui stretch weights is working out a width a second way. The two settings forms the rule's header names call none of these: ImGui fits their columns.

rules.question: What share of the room does a text column get?
rules.owner: ColumnSpec::share, read in place_columns in src/ui/column_widths.cpp
rules.decision: D243 to D245 (the user's answers on column widths, 2026-10-14)

owner_lines.why: text_shares_sum_to_100: the check that a table's shares sum to 100, which place_columns asserts in a debug build
place_columns: the shown open columns' total
place_columns: split_of, the one place a column's split is worked out; the floor check and the whole-pixel width both call it
report_frame::column_spec copies the report view's share into the column's spec, as it copies truncate; it works out no width
with_share, the one helper path_columns and dm_columns write their shares through

rules.note: The shares live once, in each table's column list (the ColumnSpec lists in src/ui and the report views' column lists in src/app). Code that reads a share outside place_columns would be working out a width of its own.
